title: Four stores at 16

captions.instagram:
By 16, I'd started four electronics and music specialty stores.

It started in our family discount store in Spanish Harlem, working beside my father, Norman. In 1976, he opened the first Wiz on Fulton Street in Brooklyn.

Swipe for the path, then save the 5 questions for your own first venture.

#Entrepreneurship #YoungEntrepreneurs #Brooklyn

What were you building at 16?
captions.facebook:
I worked beside my father, Norman, at our family discount store in Spanish Harlem. By 16, I'd started four electronics and music specialty stores of my own.

The last slide has 5 questions for anyone thinking about a first venture.

#Entrepreneurship #SmallBusiness

What was your first job or first business?
captions.linkedin:
You don't need to feel ready to start. You need someone to learn beside and a small first version.

I worked beside my father, Norman N. Jemal, at our family discount store in Spanish Harlem. By 16, I had started four electronics and music specialty stores.

Five questions I'd ask before a first venture:
1. What can I already do well?
2. Who can I learn beside?
3. What need can I serve?
4. What's the smallest version I can start?
5. What will the first try teach me?

#Entrepreneurship #Leadership

Who did you learn your trade beside?
